notes.title: Luxury Drinks Season
notes.content:
Hello, crypto millionaire.

A new patch has been released, which means a new season is already knocking at your door, and you can open it, we are not a military recruiting center, after all

A new season of elite drinks, with a new batch that we brought:
[list]
[*] Bloody Tears (rare)
[*] Whisconti (epic)
[*] White Death (legendary)
[*] Hennesis (heroic)
[/list]
These items will no longer be available at the end of the season, so buy your drinks while you can!

Come and show what a connoisseur of high-quality alcohol you are, prove that you are a badass!

notes.title: Cocktail Season
notes.content:
Hello elderly business sharks

We've decided to get off the couch and release the first patch that will make you spit less into your screen

The first season has started: Cocktail Season!
Added 4 new and exclusive items:
[list]
[*] Mojito Mix (Rare)
[*] Martinez (Epic)
[*] Green Ghost (Legendary)
[*] Fall Mood (Heroic)
[/list]
These will be available to get in game or buy during the week, starting today and running through next Friday. 

Other (very important) changes:
[list]
[*] added protection against autoclickers
[*] fixed saving of stats after progress reset
[*] added game tips
[*] fixed a bug with stat scaling on reloading
[*] added in-game store
[*] reset recharge time increased from 1.5 to 3 hours
[/list]
Make the bald man sweat and get delicious drinks from the cocktail season that you can treat your alt-girl
